verbatim_quote.original: The closure XML must instruct the Hands to: move the file to `tasks/completed/` via `git mv`, set `**Status:** closed`, update the `**File:**` header to the new `tasks/completed/` path, log the Manager's accept quote in the Execution Log, then run `custom_context_commit_and_clean_task` as the ONLY commit path. Scope the XML to these closure steps only.
